contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy radiate of Carausius (AD 286-93) (Reece Period 14). Obverse:Radiate bust, draped, right. Inscription: [ ] CARAVSIVS P AV[prob clear]. Reverse: Pax standing left with transverse sceptre and branch. No mint mark visible. Inscription: PAX A[VG]. Unattributed Mint. RIC V, pt 2, p. 536, cf 896. Oval flan with attractive dark green patina and very little wear but some light surface verdigris/corrosion and remnants of silver wash. The coin is 21.67mm long, 17.16mm wide, 2.16mm thick, diameter 21.67mm and weighs 3.6g. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC
